spans.text: This isn't right, Evelyn.

units.rawText: What do you mean?

units.displayText: We're carrying out Doll and human integration training, but the situation hasn't improved all week.

spans.text: The training's been going on for a week, and we've been punished the whole time.

units.rawText: We need to carry out our orders, no matter how ridiculous they are.
units.displayText: We need to carry out our orders, no matter how ridiculous they are.

spans.text: We need to carry out our orders, no matter how ridiculous they are.

units.rawText: Both humans and Dolls have been punished. We have no basis to object.
units.displayText: Both humans and Dolls have been punished. We have no basis to object.

spans.text: Both humans and Dolls have been punished. We have no basis to object.

units.rawText: Your platoon has only just been rolled out and there's a lot of information which hasn't been synced to you yet. I'll send it to you now.
units.displayText: Your platoon has only just been rolled out and there's a lot of information which hasn't been synced to you yet. I'll send it to you now.

spans.text: Your platoon has only just been rolled out and there's a lot of information which hasn't been synced to you yet. I'll send it to you now.

units.rawText: Humans and Dolls have never truly been integrated into a single unit... Humans can work together with Dolls, but with segregated contingents as the basic unit.
units.displayText: Humans and Dolls have never truly been integrated into a single unit... Humans can work together with Dolls, but with segregated contingents as the basic unit.

spans.text: Humans and Dolls have never truly been integrated into a single unit... Humans can work together with Dolls, but with segregated contingents as the basic unit.

units.rawText: I've simulated many tactical plans ever since I got this mission, but none of them are suitable for a mixed unit.
units.displayText: I've simulated many tactical plans ever since I got this mission, but none of them are suitable for a mixed unit.

spans.text: I've simulated many tactical plans ever since I got this mission, but none of them are suitable for a mixed unit.

units.rawText: I've gone through the things you've sent me. Is this the only reason why you're having doubts? This isn't like you, adjutant. I know there's more to it than you let on.
units.displayText: I've gone through the things you've sent me. Is this the only reason why you're having doubts? This isn't like you, adjutant. I know there's more to it than you let on.

spans.text: I've gone through the things you've sent me. Is this the only reason why you're having doubts? This isn't like you, adjutant. I know there's more to it than you let on.

units.rawText: I'm just the platoon leader, not the instructor, so relax.
units.displayText: I'm just the platoon leader, not the instructor, so relax.

spans.text: I'm just the platoon leader, not the instructor, so relax.

units.rawText: Alright, Evelyn. I guess you can tell that those human soldiers are rejecting us.
units.displayText: Alright, Evelyn. I guess you can tell that those human soldiers are rejecting us.

spans.text: Alright, Evelyn. I guess you can tell that those human soldiers are rejecting us.

units.rawText: Indeed, but human soldiers are still soldiers, and our orders are absolute.
units.displayText: Indeed, but human soldiers are still soldiers, and our orders are absolute.

spans.text: Indeed, but human soldiers are still soldiers, and our orders are absolute.

units.rawText: I don't see how we can be more efficient at fighting as a mixed unit than separately.
units.displayText: I don't see how we can be more efficient at fighting as a mixed unit than separately.

spans.text: I don't see how we can be more efficient at fighting as a mixed unit than separately.

units.rawText: Didn't a mixed unit of Dolls and humans obtain 16 gold medals in the Kantal Military Games? Don't be so negative.
units.displayText: Didn't a mixed unit of Dolls and humans obtain 16 gold medals in the Kantal Military Games? Don't be so negative.

spans.text: Didn't a mixed unit of Dolls and humans obtain 16 gold medals in the Kantal Military Games? Don't be so negative.

units.rawText: It's not the same. They call it a mixed unit, but the delegation to the Kantal Games were actually composed of two teams of humans and Dolls, each competing on their own.
units.displayText: It's not the same. They call it a mixed unit, but the delegation to the Kantal Games were actually composed of two teams of humans and Dolls, each competing on their own.

spans.text: It's not the same. They call it a mixed unit, but the delegation to the Kantal Games were actually composed of two teams of humans and Dolls, each competing on their own.

units.rawText: Instructor Python is here, and I believe he can lead us to first place again, like in Kantal.

spans.text: Instructor Python is here, and I believe he can lead us to first place again, like in Kantal.

units.rawText: All we can do now is place our hopes on his plan.
units.displayText: All we can do now is place our hopes on his plan.

units.displayText: Evelyn suddenly turns around and gazes off into the distance.

units.rawText: What's the matter, Evelyn?
units.displayText: What's the matter, Evelyn?

spans.text: What's the matter, Evelyn?

units.rawText: It's an optical imaging telescope. The humans are spying on us.
units.displayText: It's an optical imaging telescope. The humans are spying on us.

spans.text: It's an optical imaging telescope. The humans are spying on us.

units.rawText: At the human barracks, Krasno.
units.displayText: At the human barracks, Krasno.

units.rawText: Mmm...
units.displayText: Mmm...

spans.text: Mmm...

units.rawText: Are you done gawking at them? If you are, complete these two sets of exercises, quit wasting time.
units.displayText: Are you done gawking at them? If you are, complete these two sets of exercises, quit wasting time.

spans.text: Are you done gawking at them? If you are, complete these two sets of exercises, quit wasting time.

units.rawText: Stop pushing me, this is the good stuff right here. Frankly speaking, that tin can is pretty hot.
units.displayText: Stop pushing me, this is the good stuff right here. Frankly speaking, that tin can is pretty hot.

spans.text: Stop pushing me, this is the good stuff right here. Frankly speaking, that tin can is pretty hot.

units.rawText: So what if she is? This is a training camp, not a night club.

units.rawText: What the hell are you two doing?
units.displayText: What the hell are you two doing?

spans.text: What the hell are you two doing?

units.rawText: Oh, you're here at last, Leader. This guy's been slacking off and peeping at the barracks on the other side.
units.displayText: Oh, you're here at last, Leader. This guy's been slacking off and peeping at the barracks on the other side.

spans.text: Oh, you're here at last, Leader. This guy's been slacking off and peeping at the barracks on the other side.

units.rawText: Don't listen to him, Leader, I was gathering intel on the enemy!
units.displayText: Don't listen to him, Leader, I was gathering intel on the enemy!

spans.text: Don't listen to him, Leader, I was gathering intel on the enemy!

units.rawText: You're considering them the enemy now? We still need to train with them later on.
units.displayText: You're considering them the enemy now? We still need to train with them later on.

spans.text: You're considering them the enemy now? We still need to train with them later on.

units.rawText: So what if we're training with them? You're not really going to treat them as battle buddies, are you? They're lucky we don't take them down a peg!
units.displayText: So what if we're training with them? You're not really going to treat them as battle buddies, are you? They're lucky we don't take them down a peg!

spans.text: So what if we're training with them? You're not really going to treat them as battle buddies, are you? They're lucky we don't take them down a peg!

units.rawText: Take them down a peg? Hey, those tin cans may look about as strong as a block of tofu, but they can lift this load-bearing crate with one hand! If you try to start something with them, they might end up flattening you before you can even lift a finger!
units.displayText: Take them down a peg? Hey, those tin cans may look about as strong as a block of tofu, but they can lift this load-bearing crate with one hand! If you try to start something with them, they might end up flattening you before you can even lift a finger!

units.rawText: That's enough. Pack it in, you two. You especially, put that damn telescope away before they spot you.

units.rawText: What did I tell you? I don't like Dolls either, but don't look down on them.
units.displayText: What did I tell you? I don't like Dolls either, but don't look down on them.

spans.text: What did I tell you? I don't like Dolls either, but don't look down on them.

units.rawText: ...So what? We're humans! What right do they have to compare themselves to us!?
units.displayText: ...So what? We're humans! What right do they have to compare themselves to us!?

spans.text: ...So what? We're humans! What right do they have to compare themselves to us!?

units.rawText: That's enough, stop making a fuss. We're screwed if that Doll instructor catches us.
units.displayText: That's enough, stop making a fuss. We're screwed if that Doll instructor catches us.

spans.text: That's enough, stop making a fuss. We're screwed if that Doll instructor catches us.

units.rawText: It's one thing to listen to our seniors' commands, but why the hell do we have to let that tin can work us over?
units.displayText: It's one thing to listen to our seniors' commands, but why the hell do we have to let that tin can work us over?

spans.text: It's one thing to listen to our seniors' commands, but why the hell do we have to let that tin can work us over?

units.rawText: I can't accept that! Can't we do anything about it? Since when could Dolls boss humans around?
units.displayText: I can't accept that! Can't we do anything about it? Since when could Dolls boss humans around?

spans.text: I can't accept that! Can't we do anything about it? Since when could Dolls boss humans around?

units.rawText: Does it matter whether or not you can accept it? All they need to do is pound you into the ground like a post with their mechanical arms and say "oops sorry, orders from above."

units.rawText: Leader, what do you make of all this? Don't tell me you don't care. I've served for so long but after the Dolls came out, it feels like everything's changed.
units.displayText: Leader, what do you make of all this? Don't tell me you don't care. I've served for so long but after the Dolls came out, it feels like everything's changed.

spans.text: Leader, what do you make of all this? Don't tell me you don't care. I've served for so long but after the Dolls came out, it feels like everything's changed.

units.rawText: I can let everything else slide, but there's no way a Doll can be in charge of us.
units.displayText: I can let everything else slide, but there's no way a Doll can be in charge of us.

spans.text: I can let everything else slide, but there's no way a Doll can be in charge of us.

units.rawText: That's none of my concern. I only care about the Military Games in three months' time. Besides, the instructor was sent directly from HQ. Or are you going to disobey orders?
